name: ODRIV
description: Driveability rating and powertrain evaluation workbook for target vehicle analysis.

steps.title: Open the workbook
steps.description: Launch ODRIV_v29_2_1_AT.xlsm and enable macros when prompted.
tips: Save a local copy before editing configurations.

steps.title: Configure target vehicle
steps.description: Go to the TARGET VEHICLE sheet and select the drive version and vehicle model.
tips: Use default values during the testing phase.

steps.title: Set powertrain parameters
steps.description: Open the POWERTRAIN sheet and choose engine type (GASOLINE or DIESEL).
tips: Check color thresholds (rouge, orange, vert) for rating bands.

steps.title: Run calculations
steps.description: Navigate to Calculs and verify input parameters before triggering the rating workflow.

steps.title: Review results
steps.description: Check the Résultats and RATING sheets for Driveability and Responsiveness indices.
tips: Export or screenshot results for your report.
